communications.subject: Michigan Freedom of Information Act Request: September 2026 911 Calls Report
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Michigan Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

From 9/11/2026 to 9/13/2026:

- CAD/calls-for-service log dispatched to the address 13165 Lakeview Dr, Belleville, MI 48111

- All incident reports for the address 13165 Lakeview Dr, Belleville, MI 48111

- 911/dispatch audio recordings made about the address 13165 Lakeview Dr, Belleville, MI 48111

I also request that:

- in the event the request is denied, the specific subsection of MCL 15.243 listing the reason is cited, and
- should exempt portions of the request exist, they are redacted under MCL 15.244 rather than the whole record withheld.

Because audio recordings may be subject to routine deletion, please preserve all responsive records while this request is pending.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Mark Henke
